items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: Dennis Dreith who was president of the RMA at that time... 'Hal you’ve got to do that.'

ctx.x: Yes. Well you’ve had a fruitful career and I appreciate the stories you offered today and the information about the musicians’ union, which sometimes is misunderstood.

Yes. When I was a player what got me involved was the president at that time made a deal with the Pantages Theater, a Neiderlander Hotel venue. And so I thought they aren’t helping us. They didn’t give us really an increase in wages or make anything any better. So then a friend of mine, Bob Hardaway, a tenor sax player, he was the guy that played the tenor jazz solo on the Dean Martin shows on “Everybody Loves Somebody Sometime.” During the bridge he had played that solo. And he was the one that got me involved…

and a few other prominent figures, “Hal you’ve got to do that.” So I went ahead and I thought, you know it’s been a fun thing to do but you know I’ve done it. I’ve had enough of it. And I thought maybe I can help others with better contracts maybe. So I ran and I won. And then I ended up being president for ten years. And the fun part about that is I was dealing with musicians that I worked with all the time. They would be on the theater committee, they’d be on the motion picture committee or the symphony…
